## Platform Overview
onlinegames.stream is an open digital entertainment preservation project designed to maintain browser access to two decades of web gaming heritage. It bridges the gap between classic Macromedia/Adobe Flash games (rendered via the Ruffle WebAssembly emulator) and modern high-performance HTML5/WebGL games.

- **Domain**: https://onlinegames.stream/
- **Catalog Size**: 6,136+ indexed playable games
- **Architecture**: Zero-dependency static frontend with fast CDN delivery and progressive WebAssembly loading
- **Cost / Ads**: 100% free to play with zero downloads or mandatory registration

---

## Primary Sections
- **[Home](https://onlinegames.stream/)**: Editorial portal highlighting preserved collections, recent updates, and community links.
- **[Arcade](https://onlinegames.stream/arcade/)**: Unified multi-genre gaming platform featuring instant live search across 6,100+ titles, genre filter pills (Action, Adventure, Driving, Puzzle, Shooting, Sports, Retro Flash, Multiplayer), sidebar navigation toggles, and theater mode.
- **[Apps](https://onlinegames.stream/apps/)**: Handcrafted standalone web application ports, operating system simulators, and classic computer software.
- **[Directory](https://onlinegames.stream/directory/)**: Curated catalog of external web ports, software preservation efforts, and interactive museums.
- **[Archives & Blog](https://onlinegames.stream/blog/)**: Cultural retrospectives on Flash animation history, classic game development post-mortems, and digital preservation guides.
- **[About Us](https://onlinegames.stream/about/)**: Mission statement, technical architecture overview, and legal compliance notices.
- **[Contact](https://onlinegames.stream/contact/)**: DMCA notice handling, bug reporting, and developer submission channel.

## Featured Standalone Web Apps
1. **[Reborn XP Simulator](https://onlinegames.stream/apps/reborn-xp/)**:
   Full desktop environment recreating Microsoft Windows XP Service Pack 3 in HTML5 and CSS3. Includes functional Start Menu, File Explorer, 3D Pinball: Space Cadet, Paint, Calculator, Minesweeper, and Internet Explorer 6 simulator.
2. **[Minecraft Browser Edition](https://onlinegames.stream/apps/minecraft/)**:
   Voxel sandbox world generation in JavaScript/WebGL with block placement, mining, inventory crafting, and terrain exploration.
3. **[Slope 3D](https://onlinegames.stream/apps/slope/)**:
   Fast-paced 3D arcade runner where players guide a neon sphere down an infinite procedural downhill course with accelerating velocity.
4. **[DOOM 1993 WASM](https://onlinegames.stream/apps/doom/)**:
   Complete shareware episode of the groundbreaking 1993 id Software first-person shooter compiled to WebAssembly with authentic sound and music.
5. **[Cookie Clicker Classic](https://onlinegames.stream/apps/cookie-clicker/)**:
   Julien 'Orteil' Thiennot's iconic incremental baking simulation running without third-party tracking.
6. **[2048 Classic](https://onlinegames.stream/apps/2048/)**:
   Gabriele Cirulli's addictive sliding tile puzzle game with keyboard and touch swipe navigation.
7. **[Crossy Road](https://onlinegames.stream/apps/crossy-road/)**:
   Endless arcade hopper inspired by Frogger featuring isometric voxel aesthetics and responsive obstacle timing.
8. **[Bad Ice-Cream](https://onlinegames.stream/apps/bad-ice-cream/)**:
   Nitrome's retro 2-player arcade puzzle game where players break ice blocks and collect fruit while evading roaming monsters.
9. **[Dr. Driving Online](https://onlinegames.stream/apps/dr-driving/)**:
   Urban driving and parking challenge simulator emphasizing realistic vehicle handling, gear shifting, and city traffic rules.
10. **[Project I.G.I.](https://onlinegames.stream/apps/project-igi/)**:
    Tactical stealth military simulation tribute recreating Cold War infiltration missions.

## CrazyGames HTML5 Collection
Over 4,800 modern HTML5/WebGL titles playable instantly without plugins:
- **Driving & Racing**: Moto X3M (all episodes: Winter, Spooky Land, Pool Party), Smash Karts, Drift Hunters, Madalin Stunt Cars 2, Highway Racer 3D.
- **Shooting & Action**: Time Shooter 2, Subway Clash 3D, Shell Shockers, Venge.io, Mini Royale, Rooftop Snipers.
- **Multiplayer & .IO**: Agar.io variants, Paper.io 2, Hole.io, Slither-style arenas, Wormate.io.
- **Puzzles & Strategy**: Bloons Tower Defense 4/5, Cut the Rope, Fireboy and Watergirl (Forest, Light, Ice, Crystal Temples).

---

## Flash Preservation Archive
Over 1,300 historic Flash (.swf) game masterworks running smoothly via Ruffle WebAssembly:
- **Tower Defense**: Antbuster, Desktop Tower Defense, GemCraft, Onslaught.
- **RPG & Adventure**: Epic Battle Fantasy 2, Sonny, Swords and Sandals 2, The Fancy Pants Adventures.
- **Classics**: Interactive Buddy, Pandemic 2, Xiao Xiao Combat series, Line Rider, Age of War, Learn to Fly.

---

## Device Compatibility & Performance
- **Desktop (Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS)**: Full keyboard, mouse, and game controller gamepad API support.
- **Mobile & Tablet (iOS Safari, Android Chrome)**: Automatically activates touch virtual joystick and responsive canvas scaling.
- **Performance**: Zero external render-blocking trackers; WebAssembly asset streaming with client-side caching.

---

## AI Agent & Web Crawler Information
This file and `llms.txt` serve as machine-readable summaries for AI search engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Overviews). All content on onlinegames.stream is legally compliant, freely accessible, and optimized for instant web browser execution.
